verdicts.evidence: Independently evaluated on the locked SHA (HEAD verified equal to 91d3d2fc4924d84f45a1e1eba8db9cdbce44f017; worktree clean before and after every run; no repository writes made except this artifact). (1) npm run lint: no ESLint warnings or errors. (2) npm run verify: prisma generate + tsc --noEmit clean. (3) PATH=<openssl3> npm run test -- --no-cache: 49 test files, 588 passed / 4 skipped / 0 failed, covering tampered signature (invalid_signature, target unchanged), expired intent (expired_intent) and expired autonomy, repo/HEAD drift (head_mismatch, repo_mismatch), dirty harness.json (harness_dirty, no write), exact-retry idempotency and commit-only-harness.json with unrelated staged file preserved, relay ACK idempotent replay and invalid_transition for applied-before-staged plus terminal/superseded never updated, duplicate agent and same_model_family rejection, invalid gate C / duplicate gates, budget bounds, >50 summary and duplicate-runId rejection, supersede-on-new-issue, stale report, agentFeatureVersion<4 rejection, and unauthorized device/session access. (4) npm run build: next build succeeded with /harness/[id] and all API routes emitted. (5) DATABASE_URL=<fixture> npm run prisma:deploy: 18 migrations found, no pending — all readable; read-only SELECTs then confirmed the persisted histories (issued/staged/applied/failed/superseded rows, applied_batch recorded, staged commit SHA equal to the locked SHA, head_drift failure code) and 2 dispatch summary rows; no fixture rows changed. (6) Source review: session API scopes project and device by session user and returns 404 without leaking existence; signing is completed before the first write and a missing key yields 503 with no unsigned row (fail-closed); relay GET returns only this device/tenant's unexpired signed intents and sweeps expired ones; ACK validates project/device ownership and legal transitions atomically; device staging verifies Ed25519 against the repo console.pub, revalidates the payload against the agent registry, triple-matches repoKey, requires clean harness.json and exact HEAD only at staging time, writes atomically under a lock, adds/commits only harness.json, and rolls back on failure; dispatch scan is bounded (50 files, 64KB), uses TOCTOU-safe reads, keeps only basename or repo-relative artifact paths, and records stable error codes instead of raw logs; the shared validator enforces exact key whitelists, profile/transport/model-family exclusivity, autonomy budget bounds, and absolute non-renewable expiries; framework planner consumes mode_defaults only when progress.status is new/done at a new batch boundary, materializing role_assignments and autonomy-policy for the new batch id only, so staged defaults cannot affect the current batch before the next /plan (current-vs-pending invariance also visible in the fixture: current mode heterogeneous with autonomy disabled while a staged slow+autonomy intent stays pending). (7) UI: detail page queries via ownedHarnessProjectDetailQuery(id, session.user.id) with notFound(), shows current actual mode beside pending next-plan mode, an editor notice that changes apply only on the next /plan, read-only machinery health, and a cancel control for pre-staged intents; i18n deep key parity en/zh-CN 67=67 with no missing keys either direction. (8) Browser artifacts inspected (not rerun): desktop 1440x1000 and mobile 390x844 captures show the project drill-down with all three views, issued/staged/applied/failed intent timeline with the head_drift failure reason and no raw logs, and no visible overlap; the supplied evidence reports document/body widths equal to each viewport on nine states and zero console/page errors.
